clue.text: Impassive as bone is set in concrete

indicators.note: being set in something means being embedded inside it, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: concrete is solid, hard and firm
T as in a T-bone steak

explanation.surface: Something unmoving, like a bone embedded in a concrete block.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as bone' asks for the letter that goes with bone in T-bone, a cut of steak. 'is set in' puts that T inside SOLID.
explanation.definitionFit: Stolid and impassive are synonyms, both describing someone who shows little emotion.

clue.text: Underwear for musicians?

parts.note: skimpy briefs share a name with the lowest string on a violin, so musicians seem to have their own lingerie

explanation.surface: A joke about what orchestral players wear beneath their concert black.
explanation.definitionFit: A G-string is both a scanty piece of underwear and the string tuned to G on a violin or similar instrument.

clue.text: Revolting pimp steals manuscript

indicators.note: revolting read as rising up or overturning, so the letters that follow are turned over into a new order

explanation.surface: A disgusting procurer makes off with a valuable old document.
explanation.definitionFit: A palimpsest is a manuscript whose original writing was scraped off so the page could be reused.

clue.text: Appreciates where archaeologists work

definitions.meaning: dig is slang for like or enjoy
an excavation site is called a dig, and the plural names the places they toil

explanation.surface: Someone who enjoys visiting excavation sites.
explanation.definitionFit: Digs is slang for likes or enjoys, and archaeological excavations are known as digs.

clue.text: Reverse network grids oddly broadcast beeps, perhaps

indicators.note: Reverse tells you to read the whole run of pieces that follows from back to front

parts.note: LAN is a local area network

indicators.note: oddly picks the first, third and fifth letters of the word grids

parts.note: to broadcast is to emit

explanation.surface: Instructions for flipping network grids for some kind of transmission.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reverse' turns the whole string LAN + GIS + EMIT backwards: TIME from EMIT, SIG from GIS, NAL from LAN. GIS comes from 'grids oddly'.
explanation.definitionFit: The pips broadcast on the hour by radio stations such as the BBC are a time signal; beeps are one example.

clue.text: Find fault with entry missing from woodwork

indicators.note: missing from says the word entry is absent from the longer word, so those letters are taken out

parts.note: carpentry is woodwork
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone criticising a joiner's work because a doorway was left out.
explanation.definitionFit: To carp is to complain or nag about trivial things, which is to find fault.

clue.text: Army arrived first in this, secretly

indicators.note: arrived first says the word for arrived comes before the army abbreviation

parts.note: came means arrived
RA, the Royal Artillery, is a common crossword stand-in for army

explanation.surface: Troops turned up early at some covert location.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition works through the phrase 'in camera', a legal term for proceedings held in private.
explanation.definitionFit: Hearings held in private chambers are said to take place in camera, so secretly is in this.

clue.text: Soldiers curse their clothes

parts.note: men means soldiers, as in officers and men
to curse is to swear

explanation.surface: Troops swearing about their uniforms.
explanation.definitionFit: Menswear is clothing for males, and the soldiers and the men are the 'they' of their.

clue.text: Conductor of opera with Mimi's new maiden replaced

parts.note: Tosca is an opera by Puccini

indicators.note: with ... replaced applies the swap again, so the second maiden letter in the name changes too
replaced says every maiden letter in the name is swapped out for the new letter

parts.note: Mimi is the heroine of Puccini's La Boheme
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: A conductor directing an opera in which the soprano role of Mimi is recast.
explanation.walkthrough: Both Ms of MIMI change to N, giving NINI. Toscanini conducted the premiere of La Boheme, so the surface is apt.
explanation.definitionFit: Arturo Toscanini was a celebrated Italian orchestral and opera conductor.

clue.text: Astonished to find silver on silverback, perhaps

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
a silverback is a mature male gorilla, an example of an ape

explanation.surface: Amazement at seeing grey hair on a gorilla's back.
explanation.definitionFit: Agape describes a mouth wide open in wonder, so it means astonished.

clue.text: Parrots smuggled in rear of motor vehicles

indicators.note: smuggled in says one piece is slipped inside the other

parts.note: lories are small brightly coloured parrots

indicators.note: rear of takes the last letter of the word motor

explanation.surface: Birds being smuggled in the backs of cars.
explanation.definitionFit: Lorries are large goods vehicles, the British word for trucks.

clue.text: Fleet set forth

definitions.meaning: fleet as an adjective means fast, like a fast train
to state or put into words

explanation.surface: A navy setting out to sea.
explanation.definitionFit: An express is fast, as fleet is, and to express an idea is to set it forth.

clue.text: Assume consent is overridden

indicators.note: overridden read as ridden over, turned over, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: a nod is a sign of consent

explanation.surface: Taking it for granted that agreement will be ignored.
explanation.definitionFit: To don clothes is to put them on, one sense of assume, as in assuming a disguise.

clue.text: Pour egg on snow

definitions.meaning: to come down heavily as rain
to urge on or hasten something
falling snow is an example of what comes down from clouds

explanation.surface: A kitchen instruction for drizzling eggs over a fluffy white topping.
explanation.definitionFit: Precipitate can mean to fall as rain, to hasten or urge an event, and as a noun matter that falls, such as snow.

clue.text: Filmmaker to sensationalise hollow admission by scientist

indicators.note: admission by the scientist means he lets the piece into himself, so it goes inside

parts.note: Albert Einstein, the physicist

indicators.note: hollow empties the word sensationalise, keeping only its outer letters

explanation.surface: A film director accused of hyping a scientist's empty confession.
explanation.definitionFit: Sergei Eisenstein was the Soviet director of Battleship Potemkin, a pioneering filmmaker.

clue.text: Ornament would suit taller build

indicators.note: build means put together, so these letters are assembled in a new order

explanation.surface: A tailor's remark that decorating a suit would suit a taller frame.
explanation.definitionFit: To ornament a book is to illustrate it, adorning the text with pictures.

clue.text: Glue shampoo lid into top of head

indicators.note: into says the letter goes inside the other piece

parts.note: the pate is the crown of the head

indicators.note: a lid sits on top, so it takes the first letter of shampoo

explanation.surface: A bathroom mishap where a shampoo cap gets stuck to someone's scalp.
explanation.definitionFit: Paste is a soft adhesive, a kind of glue.

clue.text: Irregular verb nearly split by definition

indicators.note: split by means the phrase is broken open to admit the other piece

parts.note: per se is Latin for by itself, intrinsically, by definition

indicators.note: nearly drops the last letter of the word verb

explanation.surface: A grammar note: an irregular verb is by definition divided.
explanation.definitionFit: Perverse means contrary or deviating from the norm, which can be glossed as irregular.

clue.text: Odd characters in skiing trip

indicators.note: the odd characters are the first, third and fifth letters of skiing; the same run across characters in is a coincidence

explanation.surface: Something strange happening on a ski holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: A trip is a slip or mistake, and a sin is a moral lapse.

clue.text: Threaten disgrace

definitions.meaning: ..., rhyming with flower, means to look dark and menacing
to ... oneself is to demean or debase

explanation.surface: Menacing someone with public shame.
explanation.definitionFit: Lower can mean to scowl or look menacing and also to degrade someone.

clue.text: Pull out of accompanying minor the wrong way

parts.note: with means accompanying

indicators.note: the wrong way says the word is turned round to read backwards

parts.note: a ward is a minor under a guardian's care

explanation.surface: Removing a child who went off in the wrong direction.
explanation.definitionFit: To withdraw from something is to pull out of it.

clue.text: Square corners supply hard puzzles

parts.note: to rig is to fit out or equip, to supply
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard
tangles are knotty puzzles

explanation.surface: An offer to provide difficult brainteasers for a crossword corner.
explanation.definitionFit: A square's corners are each ninety degrees, the angles of that name.

clue.text: Strip for one who puts on clothes?

definitions.meaning: a long beam or band of metal used for support

definitions.text: for one who puts on clothes?
definitions.meaning: to gird is to dress or put on clothing, so one who does so is jokingly named after it

explanation.surface: A strip club joke about a performer who dresses rather than undresses.
explanation.definitionFit: A girder is a supporting beam, a strip of metal, and gird means to clothe oneself.

clue.text: Unseaworthy vessel's infection concealed presence of uranium

indicators.note: concealed means the infection piece hides the other inside it

parts.note: TB, tuberculosis, is an infection
U is the chemical symbol for uranium

explanation.surface: A rotten boat hiding radioactive material and a disease.
explanation.definitionFit: Tub is a disparaging word for a slow or leaky boat.

clue.text: Slug in batter left as replacement for food initially

indicators.note: left as replacement applies to both such letters, so the second one is swapped as well
replacement for says the left letter takes the place of the initial of food

parts.note: to buffet is to batter

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of food

explanation.surface: Cooking instructions for a slug coated in batter with the food left behind.
explanation.walkthrough: Both Fs of BUFFET become L.
explanation.definitionFit: Slug is slang for a bullet, the projectile from a gun.

clue.text: In hearing, give others a going over

indicators.note: a going over is a rough handling, so these letters are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: Advice heard nearby to give other people a thorough inspection.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition works through the phrase 'in earshot', within hearing distance.
explanation.definitionFit: Within earshot means within range of hearing, so in hearing and in earshot match.

clue.text: Stag party is unending after taking heroin

parts.note: H is slang for heroin

indicators.note: unending removes the first and last letters of party

explanation.surface: A bachelor party that drags on once drugs are involved.
explanation.definitionFit: A hart is a male deer, a stag.

clue.text: Way to get a gross litre of pastry

parts.note: St is an abbreviation for street, a way
gross means rude or crude

explanation.surface: A route to obtaining a large quantity of pastry.
explanation.definitionFit: Strudel is a layered pastry, often filled with apple.

clue.text: Lounge without any right until now

indicators.note: without any says the letter is dropped from the phrase

parts.note: so far means until now

explanation.surface: A lounge that has had no right of way up to this point.
explanation.definitionFit: A lounge, in the sense of a couch or settee, is a sofa.

clue.text: Film of queen following woman

indicators.note: following says the queen piece comes after the woman piece

parts.note: she is a woman
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the queen

explanation.surface: A movie about a queen trailing behind a woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A sheer is a very thin, gauzy fabric, a film of material.

clue.text: Nut in grease you gobbled up noisily

parts.note: fat is grease

indicators.note: noisily tells you to take a word by how it sounds when spoken

parts.note: the letter U sounds like you
ate means gobbled up

explanation.surface: Someone noisily wolfing a nut cooked in grease.
explanation.definitionFit: An infatuate is a person besotted with something, a fan or nut.
